verdict.rationale: Grafana's provisioning system explicitly supports defining dashboards, data sources, and alerts via version-controlled config files, and the observability-as-code docs describe JSON models, Terraform, and API/CLI-based provisioning for CI/CD pipelines. This is corroborated by an official OpenAPI spec and CLI docs enabling scripted/repeatable provisioning. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer accounts specifically validating Terraform/JSON-as-code workflows in production, and no community evidence directly confirms this specific workflow (only general provisioning docs).
